scope: Synthetic causal-interface feasibility audit, not learner scoring
input_contract: 95 chronological route events, route IDs 0..23; identical traces supplied to every primitive. Episode-local reset. No calendar signal, target or reference output supplied to independent controls.
target_contract: Generator mode 0 or 1 determines first two events: mode 0 => (0,1), mode 1 => (1,0). The binary outcome equals this exogenous mode. Exactly the same 93-event suffix is attached to both members of a pair: 91 distractors from routes 2..23, then fixed terminal events (0,1). Mode is never computed from any unit output.
pair_contract: Within each pair, route histogram, last-occurrence ordering, distractor suffix and event count are identical; only the first-cue order changes. Both target classes occur exactly once per pair.

independent_controls.leaky_analog: 24 scalar traces initialized to 0. At each tick, every trace becomes 0.95*trace + (0.05 if active route else 0). Emit every observed route with its positive final trace as strength. No threshold, reset-on-output, cooldown or reference call.
independent_controls.first_visit: Record first occurrence index for each observed route, bounded by 95 events. Emit route strength 1/(1+first_index). No threshold, decay, spike, cooldown, reference call or target access.
independent_controls.histogram: Emit observed route strength count/95; static order-blind reference.

reference: Retained pure LIF admission from electricity v2, comparison routes only; unchanged source identity
matching_limit: Shared input, route vocabulary and resource ceilings, not identical actual storage, arithmetic, strengths or admitted information. Analog/first-visit controls are independently deployable but do not isolate spike biology by themselves.
synthetic_suffix_plan: One constant route-2 distractor block, one cycling 2..23 block, and 100 random blocks of length 91 from routes 2..23 using seed 6200410. Append fixed terminal (0,1) to each block to form a 93-event suffix. Both paired modes share each suffix.
feasibility_gate: Reject a primitive as an eligible learning comparator for this exact target when opposite-label pair members produce identical readout signatures. Report collisions, not accuracy or fitted quality. First-visit and analog controls must preserve cue order; histogram must collide. If LIF collides, do not preregister a learning superiority claim on this output interface.
stop_rule: No tuning on these fixtures or consumed electricity scores. This audit authorizes no learning run. A later learning protocol requires a separate target/interface identity and disclosure of this feasibility result. Keep 2014 sealed.
